fusions.name: Roasting Brand
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Throws a brand that deals 7 fire damage and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. 20% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bonfire Banquet
fusions.desc: Raises a bonfire around you, dealing 26 fire damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their resistances, and setting them [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. You restore 15 health.

fusions.name: Warm Meal
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds. You carry 15% fire resistance.

fusions.name: Burnt Down to Embers
fusions.desc: As one of your afflictions on an enemy runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
